response.justification: Bogdan has strong full-stack engineering experience, demonstrated leadership in AI-agent infrastructure and MCP tooling, and deep hands-on work with cloud platforms and data systems — all highly relevant. However, he lacks explicit evidence of 8+ years focused on production-grade GenAI systems, vector databases, or RAG architectures, and his resume emphasizes diverse tools over deep specialization in GenAI, raising questions about senior-level readiness in this niche.
strengths: Experience with AI-agent infrastructure and Model Context Protocol (MCP) tooling at re:cinq
Proven track record building scalable cloud-native systems on AWS and Kubernetes
Strong technical leadership through workshops, open-source contributions, and cross-team mentorship
concerns: No clear evidence of 8+ years dedicated to GenAI or production AI systems
Missing explicit mention of vector databases, RAG, or LLM optimization techniques
Limited demonstration of enterprise customer-facing technical leadership or consulting
